outcome: emergency room (ER) utilization (>=1 ER visit) in the 6 months postpartum
cohort: The study included 26,074 pregnancies among women aged 12-45 years who were continuously enrolled in Maryland Medicaid for at least 100 days of pregnancy and 90 days postpartum.
finding: Women with pregnancy complications (GDM, gestational hypertension, or preeclampsia) were more likely to have at least one ER visit in the 6 months postpartum, especially those under age 25 years.
